findings.evidence: SW4 is in series with the battery negative terminal. Its selected generic DIP-switch footprint references CTS219, rated only 100mA. No exact SW4 MPN is specified. Estimated current at 5.02V/1A load, 3.21V input and 85% efficiency is 1.84A.
findings.action: Specify a suitably DC-rated battery disconnect, preferably 3A for the current design, and its matching footprint; alternatively move the small switch into a low-current control circuit.

findings.evidence: J14.4, U4.26 TXD and U5.34 RXD0 share the same net. An external USB-UART adapter driving J14.4 can contend with the powered CP2102N transmitter. USB absence does not establish TXD high impedance.
findings.action: Add a disconnect/jumper or mux for the CP2102N TXD path if external bidirectional UART programming/debug is required. Otherwise explicitly restrict J14 to receive-only monitoring of ESP TX and leave adapter TX disconnected.

findings.evidence: TH1 has no footprint and is the remote NTC probe, but the native schematic instance has on_board yes.
findings.action: Exclude TH1 from the PCB while retaining its probe BOM/harness documentation.

findings.evidence: Schematic J9 shield pin is S1. Existing board J9 shell pads are S1 and connected to GND. The currently installed library footprint uses SH instead.
findings.action: Preserve the existing matching footprint in a project library or normalize symbol/footprint shield numbering together before library-refresh operations. Existing board shell grounding is correct.
